title: scvi-tools input schema
description: JSON schema for params.json passed to scvi-tools.py via BioF3 dispatcher. Compatible with biof3-py-runtime scanpy>=1.9 + scvi-tools>=1.0 + torch>=2.0 (CPU).

anndata_file.description: Path to .h5ad file (relative to jobDir or absolute). Must exist and be >1KB.

batch_key.description: obs column key for batch covariate. If absent in adata.obs, scvi-tools runs in single-batch mode.

layer.description: AnnData layer containing raw counts. If missing, adata.X is used and copied to a 'counts' layer.

n_latent.description: scVI latent dimensionality (output dimension of the encoder).

device.description: Training device. 'cpu' is the G0 default to avoid GPU dependency. 'auto' picks GPU if available (G1+).
